page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance configuration provides 8 dedicated vCPUs spread across 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core, supported by 35 MB of L3 cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 KB of L1 data cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA.

System memory consists of 16.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Memory bandwidth benchmarks indicate uncached write speeds of 33.04 GB/sec, while uncached read performance reaches 38.0 GB/sec. This configuration does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage for persistent data. The instance has no hardware graphics acceleration and includes a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark outcomes demonstrate entry-level compute throughput. The processor achieved a single-core Geekbench score of 893.0 and a multi-core score of 3241.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 6992.33. Single-threaded compression speeds reached 18.9 GB/sec in gzip, while static web serving throughput measured 3.58 GB/sec. For lightweight natural language tasks using a 135M parameter model, it maintained prompt processing rates of 449.97 tokens/sec and text generation at 99.41 tokens/sec, but generation performance declined to 5.0 tokens/sec on a 7B model.

From an architectural standpoint, the instance balances dedicated core compute with standard network capabilities. The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio restricts operations requiring substantial in-memory footprints. This profile aligns with compute-driven workloads that do not demand high peak single-thread execution, including moderate CI/CD compilation stages, background batch processing, and non-intensive web applications.

It provides 8 dedicated vCPUs over 4 physical cores and 16.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The instance carries no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage, and includes a 2 Gbps baseline network interface without GPU acceleration. Benchmark measurements show a Geekbench multi-core score of 3241.0, a PassMark CPU score of 6992.33, and static web serving throughput of 3.58 GB/sec. Due to its dedicated vCPU allocation and modest memory capacity, the server is suitable for batch execution, code compilation, and standard web serving tasks.
